title: Multiplexed Immunofluorescence and RNA-FISH
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Process images using a FIJI custom pipeline.
Analyze data using software available at https://github.com/Eroglu-Lab/Irala_2024_image_analysis/blob/main/20230717_irala_fish_macro.ijm.

steps.title: Prepare and Mount Brain Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare five 20 μm brain sections containing the visual cortex from P7, P14, and P21 Aldh1L1-EGFP mice.

substeps.instruction: Mount sections directly onto glass slides

steps.title: Thaw and Wash Sections
steps.instruction: Thaw slides at room temperature for 00:05:00 to remove the cryoprotective solution and wash sections three times with 1× PBST.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with anti-GFP primary antibody (1:1,000) overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Blocking and Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Block and label sections using antibody buffer and initiator-labeled secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Block sections with antibody buffer for 01:00:00 at room temperature
Incubate sections with 100 µL initiator-labeled secondary antibody diluted in antibody buffer for 01:00:00 at room temperature

steps.title: Wash and RNA-FISH Probe Incubation
steps.instruction: Wash sections and incubate with Atp13a4 probe solution.

substeps.instruction: Wash sections with 5× sodium chloride sodium citrate containing 0.1% Tween20 (5× SSCT) for 00:05:00
Incubate sections with 100 µL of 16 nM Atp13a4 probe solution overnight at 37 °C in a humidified chamber

steps.title: Remove Excess Probes
steps.instruction: Remove excess probes by washing sections in a mixture of probe wash buffer and 5× SSCT at 37 °C, gradually increasing the concentration of 5× SSCT until ending with a 100% 5× SSCT wash.

steps.title: Signal Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify signals using amplification buffer and specific hairpin solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL amplification buffer to each section and incubate at room temperature for 00:30:00
Prepare a 60 mM hairpin solution by mixing snap-cooled hairpins specific to the initiator-labeled secondary antibody and Atp13a4 probe with amplification buffer
Incubate sections with the hairpin solution overnight at room temperature

steps.title: Final Wash and Mounting
steps.instruction: Wash sections with 5× SSCT for 00:45:00 to remove excess hairpins, then dry sections and mount with mounting medium.

steps.title: Imaging and Data Acquisition
steps.instruction: Image sections within two days using an Olympus FV 3000 microscope at high magnification (60× objective with 2× optical zoom).

substeps.instruction: Acquire z-stack images (1 μm step size, 6 μm total z-stack depth) for the visual cortex (layers L1, L2-3, L4, and L5)
Capture images from three sections per animal for three animals at each time point (P7, P14, and P21)

steps.title: Quantification
steps.instruction: Threshold and quantify Atp13a4 puncta inside and outside GFP-positive astrocyte areas.
